title: OMEGA XVII — Regulatory Handshake / Production-Failure Markets
researcherNote: Continuation from OMEGA XVI (not a recycling of OMEGA XVII-A Public Money Graph discoveries). This pass went farther into customs infrastructure, F-gases, fisheries/CATCH, batteries, EPREL, Safety Gate, EUDR, renewable-fuel registries, aviation/maritime compliance, construction passports, the brand-new End-of-Life Vehicles regulation, and emerging payment infrastructure. The major contribution is the Production-Failure Markets thesis: look for a mandatory government machine that has entered production, then find the private-company system that must successfully handshake with it.

omegaConceptualContribution: OMEGA XVII-B adds the Production-Failure Markets thesis to the research formula. The shift: from 'what regulation creates compliance work?' to 'what mandatory digital transaction can fail and stop money, goods, or operations?' This produces the Regulatory CI/CD framing and the HandshakeGraph architecture layer. Key primitives: identity + quantity + state explain a large fraction of regulatory failures; AI extracts dirty inputs; deterministic code performs the actual gate.
